subject: physics_2
question_text: What is the role of controlling rods in a nuclear reactor?

verification.note: The 1+1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. For this Physics-II paper the two-book union check and the past-paper back-test are STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material on hand is first-year physics only, and the paper corpus holds only Paper-I papers. Hand-checked: cadmium and boron have very large neutron-absorption cross-sections and are the standard control-rod materials. The book also lists BERYLLIUM as a control-rod substance; beryllium is a moderator and reflector — it scatters neutrons and slows them rather than absorbing them — so this card names cadmium and boron only.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

steps.margin_note: First mark. The word absorb, and the effect of moving the rods.
steps.why: The rods are the only fast adjustment a reactor has: their depth in the core sets how many neutrons survive to start the next generation.
common_mistakes: Saying control rods slow the neutrons down. That is the moderator.
Saying they cool the reactor. That is the coolant.

recall.must_convey: That control rods absorb neutrons in the reactor core, and moving them in or out changes how many neutrons remain.
accept: pushing them in absorbs more neutrons
rods control the number of neutrons

steps.memory_tip: Rods in, fewer neutrons; rods out, more neutrons.

lines.text: Control rods absorb neutrons, holding K = 1

steps.margin_note: Second mark. Link the rods to K = 1 and name cadmium or boron.
steps.why: The book also lists beryllium here. Beryllium scatters neutrons and slows them, so it works as a moderator and reflector, not as an absorber; cadmium and boron are the materials with the large absorption cross-sections a control rod needs.
common_mistakes: Naming graphite or heavy water. Those are moderators, not control rods.
Omitting K = 1. The purpose of the rods is the steady reaction.

recall.must_convey: That control rods keep the multiplication factor at 1 so the chain reaction is steady, and that cadmium and boron are used.
accept: they keep K equal to one
reject: they absorb neutrons in the core

steps.memory_tip: Cadmium and boron are neutron sponges; the rods dial K to exactly 1.

insider_note: Say what the rods do (absorb neutrons) and what that achieves (K held at 1). Naming a material alone is half an answer.
